Introduction Here we explore the different design for dashboard page. ## Getting Started ### Installing and Loading the Required Libraries ::: panel-tabset #### Package Description There are **13** packages that will be used in this exercise. | Package | Description | |------------------------------------|------------------------------------| | [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/) | A collection of R packages for data importing, cleaning, transformation, and visualisation (e.g., [readr](https://readr.tidyverse.org/), dplyr, tidyr, [ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/)). | | [knitr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/knitr/index.html/) | Provides a general-purpose tool for dynamic report generation in R using Literate Programming techniques. | | [DT](https://rstudio.github.io/DT/) | Displays data frames as interactive HTML tables with sorting, filtering, and pagination. | | [scales](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/scales/index.html) | Provides graphical scales map data to aesthetics. | | [ggthemes](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggthemes/index.html) | Provides 'ggplot2' themes and scales that replicate some of the famous looks. | | [readxl](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/readxl/readxl.pdf) | Imports excel files into R. | | [rlang](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rlang/index.html) | Tools for working with base types, expressions, environments, and especially “tidy evaluation. | | [plotly](https://plotly.com/r/) | Creates interactive and publication-ready graphs. | | [viridis](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/gapminder/index.html) | A dataset and visualisation concept popularised by Hans Rosling. In ggplot and gganimate, Gapminder data is often used as an example to demonstrate animated plots over time, such as countries moving across income and life expectancy.Used here solely to apply its country color scheme. | | [htmltools](https://rstudio.github.io/htmltools/) | Useful tools for creating, manipulating, and writing HTML from R. | | [timetk](https://github.com/business-science/timetk) | A cutting-edge toolkit for time series preparation and exploration. | | [stringr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/stringr/index.html) | Provides a consistent and user friendly set of functions for performing common string manipulation tasks, with functions such as `str_detect()`, `str_replace()` and `str_extract()` etc | | [lubridate](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/lubridate/index.html) | A Tidyverse package that handles date-time objects | The code below installs and loads the required packages into R environment. #### The Code ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(tidyverse, DT, readxl, knitr, scales,ggthemes, plotly, timetk, lubridate, stringr, htmltools, viridis, rlang, reactable,reactablefmtr) ``` ::: ::: ## Importing Data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cpi_data <- read_rds("data/cpi_h.rds") ``` ::: ## Building CPI Weights Table ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} names(cpi_data) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "date" "series" "cpi" "level" "division" "group" "class" ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cpi_data$series[1:66] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "Consumer Price Index (CPI)" [2] "Food" [3] "Food Excl Food & Beverage Serving Services (FFBSS)" [4] "FFBSS: Rice & Cereals" [5] "FFBSS: Meat" [6] "FFBSS: Fish & Seafood" [7] "FFBSS: Milk, Other Dairy & Eggs" [8] "FFBSS: Oils & Fats" [9] "FFBSS: Fruits & Nuts (FN)" [10] "FFBSS: Vegetables" [11] "FFBSS: Sugar, Confectionery & Desserts (SCD)" [12] "FFBSS: Ready-Made & Oth. Food Nec", 44, 3, "FFBSS: Non-Alcoholic Beverages", 41 ) # Save to CSV write_csv(aa_weights, "data/cpi_weights_series.csv") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} (aa_weights) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 66 × 3 level series weight 1 0 Consumer Price Index (CPI) 10000 2 0 All Items Less Accommodation 7344 3 0 All Items Less Imputed Rentals For Housing 7862 4 1 Food 2042 5 1 Clothing and Footwear (C&F) 165 6 1 Housing & Utilities 2938 7 1 Household Durables & Services (HDS) 547 8 1 Health 1008 9 1 Transport 1307 10 1 Information & Communication (InfoComm) 381 # ℹ 56 more rows ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cpi_weighted <- cpi_data %>% left_join(aa_weights, by = c("series", "level")) ``` ::: ## Exploring CPI Contribution Table ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} aa_compute_yoy_contribution <- function(data, selected_level = 1) { latest_date <- max(data$date, na.rm = TRUE) prev_year_date <- latest_date %m-% months(12) latest_df <- data %>% filter(level == selected_level, date == latest_date) %>% select(series, level, cpi_latest = cpi) prev_df <- data %>% filter(level == selected_level, date == prev_year_date) %>% select(series, level, cpi_prev = cpi) latest_df %>% left_join(prev_df, by = c("series", "level")) %>% left_join(aa_weights, by = c("series", "level")) %>% mutate( yoy_pct = (cpi_latest / cpi_prev - 1) * 100, contribution_pp = yoy_pct * weight / 10000 ) %>% filter(!is.na(contribution_pp)) %>% arrange(desc(contribution_pp)) } ``` ::: ### Bar Chart ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} aa_div_contrib <- aa_compute_yoy_contribution(cpi_data, selected_level = 1) %>% mutate( contribution_pp = round(contribution_pp, 2), yoy_pct = round(yoy_pct, 2), weight_pct = round(weight / 100, 2), contrib_label = sprintf("%.2f", contribution_pp), yoy_label = sprintf("%.2f", yoy_pct), weight_label = sprintf("%.2f", weight_pct) ) plot_ly( data = aa_div_contrib, x = ~contribution_pp, y = ~reorder(series, contribution_pp), type = "bar", orientation = "h", text = ~contrib_label, texttemplate = "%{text}", textposition = "inside", hovertext = ~paste0( "", series, "", "
YoY: ", yoy_label, "%", "
Weight: ", weight_label, "%", "
Contribution: ", contrib_label, " pp" ), hovertemplate = "%{hovertext}" ) %>% layout( title = "Contribution to CPI by Division", xaxis = list(title = "Contribution (percentage points)"), yaxis = list(title = "") ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ### 12 Month Trend Data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} latest_date <- max(cpi_data$date, na.rm = TRUE) dashboard_start <- latest_date %m-% months(12) cpi_dashboard <- cpi_weighted %>% filter( date >= dashboard_start, date <= latest_date, !series %in% c( "All Items Less Accommodation", "All Items Less Imputed Rentals For Housing" ) ) %>% mutate( weight_pct = weight / 100 ) %>% group_by(level, division, group, class, series) %>% arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>% mutate( cpi_prev = lag(cpi, 12), yoy_pct = (cpi / cpi_prev - 1) * 100, contribution_pp = yoy_pct * weight / 10000 ) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} write_rds(cpi_dashboard, "data/cpi_dashboard.rds") ``` ::: #### Reactable ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} aa_latest_date <-
